shipped.title: Settlement reconciliation that measures itself
shipped.thesis: A recon engine that scores its own recall against injected breaks, and refuses to force a match.

shipped.title: Deterministic freshness in shopping-concierge
shipped.thesis: A test that breaks itself 30 days after it is written is not a test. CI now catches it.

shipped.title: Profile README: thesis first, proofs second
shipped.thesis: A bare repo list became a one screen argument, with every claim linked.

shipped.title: Spend policy engine for agent-initiated payments
shipped.thesis: Agents can spend; nothing decides whether they should. Reserve at decision time and a burst cannot overrun the budget.

shipped.title: CI on the trading agent, and the macOS crash it found
shipped.thesis: The suite had never run outside one laptop. On Linux CI it failed 7 tests: the client read the Keychain in its constructor, so every authenticated path crashed with FileNotFoundError security.

shipped.title: Subscription mandate simulator across three rails
shipped.thesis: One scheduler, three rails: 99.48% kept on cards, 60.74% on SEPA, 46.87% on UPI. The rail decides the outcome, not the code.

shipped.title: Rewrite the trading agent README around what it cannot do
shipped.thesis: A rail someone wrote stopped one order and a rule nobody wrote down stopped four. The README now leads with the enforced checks and prints the run record from a committed command.

shipped.title: Money allocation and FX rounding engine
shipped.thesis: One in five payouts did not add up: 621 of 3,000 per share rounded payouts were off, by up to 2 minor units. Largest remainder balanced every one, and all 3,374 cases of an exhaustive sweep.

shipped.title: Keep tokens and the API key out of the SDK log files
shipped.thesis: The SDK's own ERROR handler wrote the bearer token and the API key into logs/ where loglevel() could not reach. A filter on the logger covers the handler the SDK attaches later.

shipped.title: Agent-to-agent credit with exposure limits and netting
shipped.thesis: A $200 cap on gross outflow carried 21.26% of the value, a $200 cap on net debit carried 97.84%, with the same worst case loss. Multilateral netting removed 94.59% of the flow.

shipped.title: Declare the public surface of every public repo, and check it
shipped.thesis: Metadata maintained by hand drifts. 5 of 7 public repos carried no topics and 4 descriptions had grown into feature piles. Desired state now lives in the repo and a committed tool fails on drift.
